title: אבין רמאה
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: Avin Rama'ah (of Botzra). He employed ‘deception’ in commandments: he let the congregation pledge and then gave as much as all of them. They seated him among the sages, as it says, “A person’s gift makes room for him”; Yelammedenu and Midrash Rabbah, Re'eh; see Jerusalem Talmud, Horayot.
